components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner (e.g. MR, MRS,
            MS, DR). When present it is combined with the last name to form the
            owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it takes
            precedence and this value is composed from the normalized address lines
            and returned here.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the structured postal address. Preferred over
            the flat 'address' when present; normalized (upper-cased, whitespace
            collapsed, common street-type abbreviations expanded) like the flat address.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the structured postal address.
            Normalized like 'addressLine1' and, when present, appended to it (separated
            by a single space) to form the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized
            to E.164 form; a leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise country
            code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national
            digits. Spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped and the result must carry
            8 to 15 digits after the '+' (e.g. '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9 ()+.-]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it
            must be a syntactically valid address and is normalized to lower-case.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when present it
            must be four digits and valid for the region derived from the city via the
            fixed city-to-region table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099).
            A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and
            returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand' against the
            registration date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, permits creating this owner even though another owner
            shares the same last name and address (i.e. they live in the same household).
            Write-only; used only when creating an owner and never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path of this owner, formed as '/api/owners/'
                followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, formed as the title followed by a
                space and the last name (e.g. 'DR Franklin'), or just the last name
                when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans, as the
                country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes
                (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last names,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: The version of the owner identity contract carried by this
                response. Version 2 rederives the region code used inside the identifiers
                (memberId, identityKey and householdId, all grouped under 'identity') with
                a fixed 'V2' version tag, so every identifier differs from its version-1
                value. The user-facing 'locality', 'timezone' and owner-segment region are
                unaffected and remain the plain region code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              title: Identity
              description: The owner's version-2 identity, grouping the rederived member id,
                identity key and household id.
              readOnly: true
              allOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registration
                date, formatted as 'FY<YY>' where the fiscal year starts on 1 July and
                YY is the last two digits of the year the fiscal year started (a date
                on or after 1 July belongs to that year's fiscal year, an earlier date
                belongs to the previous year's).
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, computed on create. It starts
                at 0, gains 2 when the owner carries an email address, gains 1 when the
                owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), gains 2 for a household of 3
                or more members, and gains 3 for tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal
                year (the registration date's fiscal year precedes the current one).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level from 1 to 4, derived from
                the membership points on create - 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3
                for 4-5 points, and 4 for 6 or more points. Because a new owner has zero
                tenure, level 4 is reserved for owners whose tenure spans at least one
                elapsed fiscal year. An owner admitted into an already-populated household
                without declaring membership is additionally capped at one level above the
                current maximum membership level among their household members; with no
                existing household member no cap applies.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners, at the time this owner was
                created, that shared the same first name and last name (compared
                case-insensitively). Excludes this owner itself.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's region derived from the city using the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or
                'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The owner's IANA timezone name derived from the locality using
                the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the
                locality is not one of these regions.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created today
                at the time this owner was created, indicating an unusually high signup
                volume; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when the owner's city already held between 40 and 49
                owners (inclusive) at the time this owner was created, indicating the
                city is approaching its hard capacity limit of 50; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, 'EMAIL' when the owner
                carries an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's segment formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>', one of
                'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or
                'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when the membershipLevel is 3 or
                more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known
                region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band derived from the birth date against the
                registration date, 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, or
                'SENIOR' at 65 and over. Absent when no birth date was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner, although not a hard duplicate, shares an
                existing owner's last name and postcode while carrying a different
                telephone, indicating a likely duplicate registration; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The ID of the existing owner this owner may duplicate (same last
                name and postcode, different telephone). Present only when
                'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: True when the owner warrants a manual risk review because any of
                three signals holds - the owner is a possible duplicate, the owner's email
                domain is disposable-adjacent (its base label matches a known disposable
                domain, catching near-variants under a different top-level domain), or the
                owner's city is over its soft capacity (it already held 40 or more owners, the
                same threshold that raises the capacity warning); otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} flags it true while retaining the record, and a
                deleted owner is ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of owners matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetPage:
      title: Pet page
      description: A page of pets.

All **70 tests pass** with `BUILD SUCCESS`. The implementation is complete. Here's a summary of what I changed to release version 2 of the owner identity:

## Changes

**1. `src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** (drives DTO generation)
- Added a new `OwnerIdentity` schema grouping `memberId`, `identityKey`, and `householdId`.
- In the `Owner` schema: removed those three from the top level, added a nested `identity` (→ `OwnerIdentity`) and a top-level integer `apiVersion`.

**2. `Owner.java`**
- Added the fixed `IDENTITY_VERSION_TAG = "V2"`.
- Added `getIdentityRegionCode()` — the plain region (`getLocality()`) with the `V2` tag mixed in, used **inside** identifiers only.
- Rederived `getIdentityKey()` to mix the `V2` tag into the SHA-256 input, so every key changes but remains a 64-hex digest and equality semantics are preserved.
- Left `getLocality()`, `getTimezone()`, and `getOwnerSegment()` on the **plain** region — the V2 tag never leaks into user-facing fields.

**3. `OwnerRestControllerV1.java`**
- `householdId(...)` now mixes the `V2` tag into its hash input (household sharing on last name + postcode is preserved).
- `memberId(...)` now uses the V2 region code (e.g. `NSWV2261A2B3C4D7`).
- The audit event moved to schema version 2: added `schemaVersion: 2` and the owner segment recomputed from the v2 identity.

**4. `OwnerMapper.java`**
- Maps `memberId`/`identityKey`/`householdId` into the nested `identity` object and sets `apiVersion = 2`.

The request fields are unchanged, and locality still resolves to the plain region (e.g. `NSW`), while the identifiers all carry the `V2` tag internally — confirmed in the audit output (e.g. `memberId=NSWV226786E13D55`, `locality "NSW"`, `ownerSegment "STANDARD_METRO"`).
